Hi André,

Thanks for your patience, and sorry for the wait on this one.

Your order Shop···· is still with us, unshipped, and it ships on November 7. The B30 batch was held up by the cooling redesign we wrote to you about in September, and your unit is in the batch now being checked in at our warehouse. You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status . Dates can shift a little as stock moves between warehouses, but November 7 is the date on your order. The P. Kit we added ships in the same box.

One thing I want to get right before it leaves. The order still carries a Wilmington, Delaware address, not the Tbilisi one you sent us. I have passed your Georgia address and your phone number to a colleague who is picking it up today so the label is corrected and your number is printed on the package. They will confirm it with you.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hello Sarah,

its good you mentioned this! The wilmington delaware shipping adress might lead to the forwarder courier service usshop.ge The order is so long ago that I do not even know exactly what was specified at the time...please check that!

Hello André,

I checked it, and you are right. The address on order Shop···· is a forwarder: (address hidden). The ···· is a mailbox number, so that is your usshop.ge account. Your Georgian phone number, (phone hidden), is already on the order and goes on the label.

So nothing is wrong with it. The parcel would go to your forwarder in Delaware and on to you from there, which is also the quickest route from our Chattanooga warehouse. If you would rather we ship it straight to (address hidden) instead, just say the word. That changes the destination country, so a colleague is picking that up today and will confirm it with you before anything moves.

One thing I want checked while they are on it. Your B30 was bought as the version matched to your address, and your address on file is in the US, so I have asked them to confirm the unit leaves with a cord that suits 220 volts in Georgia rather than a US one. They will come back to you on that too.

Your ship date is unchanged at November 7.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
